widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Help me find a list of school activity events in New York for this month.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [3.5] Incomplete task execution: Agent typed “school activity” in the search and picked New York, but failed to confirm the resulting filter pill cluster (location + topic + date) and reported events from the wrong city (Pryor Creek auto-fill).
